_meta.description: Per-sub-basin over-bank status for the 2021 DIANMU event. MEDIUM confidence: unlike 2022 (high-confidence RID SWOC bulletin), no independent 2021 RID over-bank bulletin was fetched, so the SAME gate pattern as 2022 is applied (main-channel gauge logic: Ping/Wang below-bank; the lower Chao Phraya tributaries over-bank), inferred from the Dianmu mechanism + river_gauges_2021.json. Deliberately NOT flipped to true for Ping to 'catch' Kamphaeng Phet (which flooded 226k rai in 2021) — that would be back-filling from the flood outcome. Kamphaeng Phet is therefore an honest false-negative, consistent with the 2022 method.
